description: What names and a chat over the network (shared fields, a local menu), a screen split a view a player, special moves (input sequences) and a joypad that shakes say (PLAN_GAMES_3.md, Phase 5)

input.natural_language: Once both players are in, each types a name at their own machine, and both machines show who is who

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="names" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="names" type="array" value='["", ""]' />
  <qg:multiplayer players="2" start="names" />
  <qg:scene name="title" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:lobby local="level" />
  </qg:scene>
  <!-- Enter opens the box, Enter sends it: the name reaches both machines on the same tick -->
  <qg:scene name="names" width="320" height="240">
    <q:set name="typed" value="" />
    <qg:hud position="center" size="12">
      <qg:text value="{'Player 1: ' + names[0]}" />
      <qg:text value="{'Player 2: ' + names[1]}" />
    </qg:hud>
    <qg:menu local="true" position="bottom-center">
      <qg:field bind="typed" label="Your name" shared="true" max-length="10">
        <q:set name="names" index="{sender - 1}" value="{text}" />
      </qg:field>
    </qg:menu>
    <!-- player 1 starts once both have a name -->
    <qg:on-input action="jump">
      <q:if condition="{names[0] != '' and names[1] != ''}"><qg:goto-scene name="level" /></q:if>
    </qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="level" width="320" height="240" />
</q:application>

input.natural_language: Players over the network can send each other a line; the last three lines show at the top

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="chat" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:multiplayer players="2" start="room" />
  <qg:scene name="room" width="320" height="240">
    <q:set name="line" value="" />
    <q:set name="said" type="array" value="[]" />
    <qg:menu local="true" position="bottom-center" size="10">
      <qg:field bind="line" label="Say" shared="true" max-length="40">
        <q:set name="said" value="{(said + ['P' + str(sender) + ': ' + text])[-3:]}" />
        <q:set name="line" value="" />
      </qg:field>
    </qg:menu>
    <qg:hud position="top-left" size="10">
      <qg:text value="{said[0] if len(said) > 0 else ''}" />
      <qg:text value="{said[1] if len(said) > 1 else ''}" />
      <qg:text value="{said[2] if len(said) > 2 else ''}" />
    </qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: In a fighting game, down, forward and punch in quick succession throws a hit at the other fighter from afar

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="special" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:input action="punch" keys="J" />
  <qg:input action="punch" keys="Period" player="2" />
  <qg:scene name="fight" width="640" height="360">
    <qg:character id="p1" controller="fighter" player="1" sheet="people" frame="0" x="200" y="252" hitbox="40x90">
      <qg:move name="jab" action="punch" frames="1, 2" reach="30x20" damage="6" />
    </qg:character>
    <qg:character id="p2" controller="fighter" player="2" sheet="people" frame="2" x="440" y="252" hitbox="40x90" facing="left">
      <qg:move name="jab" action="punch" frames="1, 2" reach="30x20" damage="6" />
    </qg:character>
    <!-- forward is the way the fighter faces: right for player 1 here -->
    <qg:on-input sequence="down, forward, punch" within="30" player="1">
      <q:if condition="{abs(p1.x - p2.x) < 200}"><qg:damage target="p2" amount="12" /></q:if>
    </qg:on-input>
    <qg:on-input sequence="down, forward, punch" within="30" player="2">
      <q:if condition="{abs(p1.x - p2.x) < 200}"><qg:damage target="p1" amount="12" /></q:if>
    </qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: On the title, up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right gives ninety-nine lives

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="code" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="lives" value="3" type="number" />
  <qg:scene name="title" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:hud position="top-center"><qg:text value="{'Lives: ' + str(lives)}" /></qg:hud>
    <!-- two seconds for the eight presses -->
    <qg:on-input sequence="up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right" within="120">
      <q:set name="lives" value="99" />
    </qg:on-input>
    <qg:on-input action="jump"><qg:goto-scene name="level" /></qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="level" width="320" height="240" />
</q:application>

examples.intent: A hit felt in the hands

input.natural_language: When the hero runs into a spike, the joypad shakes for a moment; at the end of the lives, a long shake

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="rumble" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="lives" value="3" type="number" />
  <qg:prefab name="Spike" tag="spike" sheet="tiles" frame="68" hitbox="18x10" />
  <qg:scene name="level" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="platformer" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="40" hitbox="14x20">
      <qg:on-collision with="spike" cooldown="60">
        <q:set name="lives" value="{lives - 1}" />
        <qg:rumble player="1" strength="0.6" seconds="0.25" />
        <q:if condition="{lives <= 0}">
          <qg:rumble player="1" strength="1" seconds="0.8" />
          <qg:goto-scene name="level" />
        </q:if>
      </qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Spike" name="spike" x="160" y="200" />
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
